title: Materials scientist: the metal acts like an animal seeking connection
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Materials scientist: the metal acts like an animal seeking connection, about 2020s at Silicon Valley / NASA, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the words I heard this metal is much acts much like an animal in that it is always seeking for energy and seeking to connect

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he attracts UFOs, recounts what a materials scientist told him in the 2020s about an unusual metal, with the setting given as Silicon Valley and NASA, the US space agency. Bledsoe says the words he heard were that this metal acts much like an animal, always seeking energy and seeking to connect, which would make it something closer to alive than any ordinary material.
